MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
25001051
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F01252923
U.S. BANK TRUST NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY BUT SOLELY AS OWNER TRUSTEE FOR RCAF ACQUISITION TRUST, is the Plaintiff, and WANDEMBERG G. GUZAAAN, ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 07/03/2024. By virtue of the above stated Writ, to me directed and delivered, I will expose to sale at public vendue on WEDNESDAY, the 11TH DAY of JUNE A.D. 2025, at the hour of one thirty o' clock by the then prevailing (Standard or Daylight Saving) time, in the afternoon of the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick, N. J . 08901 .
The property to be sold is located in the TOWNSHIP OF PISCATAWAY in the County of Middlesex, and State of New Jersey .
Premises commonjy known as: 119 ELIZABETH AVENUE, PISCATAWAY, NJ 08854
Tax Lot: 5, Tax Block: 6814
Approximate Dimensions : 100' X 100' Nearest Cross Street: BEATTY ST (APPROX 215 ft/65 m)
ESTIMATED UPSET BID AMOUNT: $175,000.00, in addition to lawful interest accruing daijy at the rate allowed by law, up to and including the actual day of sale plus any additional Sheriff fees, costs, and/or commission, and/or any additional sums as ordered by the court. Bid amount is subiect to change due to unforeseen circumstances and/or adiournment
PROEPRTY OCCUPANCY: The property is currently reporled to be owner occupied
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Office of the Regjster/Clerk of Middlesex County in Book 12221, Page 107, and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Middlesex County.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of ONE HUNDRED THIRTY TWO THOUSAND EIGHT HUNDRED SEVENTY EIGHT DOLLARS AND NINETY SIX CENTS ($132,878.96) dollars more or less, plus interest together with the costs of this sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to adjourn said sale from time to time subiect onjy to such limitations or restrictions upon the exercise of such power as may be specially provided by law or rules of the Court. Sold subiect to conditions of sale
Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid in a, certified check or official bank check at close of sale and the balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Knuckles & Manfro LLP
600 East Crescent Avenue, Suite 201
Upper Saddle River, NJ 07453
Attorneys
